Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 exception
 when others then 
 tackle_error('TimeZone Convert');
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 -- 
 if :shipped_products.unit_id is not null then
--chk_digit_query returns check_digit of the unit ID
 :shipped_products.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:shipped_products.unit_id,
 :shipped_products.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

--Check for the scheme_type from the value of check digit
 IF :shipped_products.chk_digit is not NULL THEN
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 END IF;
 
 begin
 select max(psp.product_price)
 into :shipped_products.product_price
 from pick_slip_products psp
 where psp.unit_id = :shipped_products.unit_id
 and psp.coll_date = :shipped_products.coll_date
 and psp.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and psp.product_code = :shipped_products.product_code
 and psp.aliquot = :shipped_products.aliquot
 and psp.product_status not in ('CA','RP');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 null;
 end;
 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select abo_desc
 into :shipped_products.s_abo_desc
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = :shipped_products.blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:shipped_products.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I') 
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 :shipped_products.s_abo_desc := :shipped_products.blood_type ;
 end;

 -------------------------F O R W A R E H O U S E---------------------
 begin
 select bx.warehouse_id into :shipped_products.warehouse_id

 and psp.product_code = :shipped_products.product_code
 and psp.aliquot = :shipped_products.aliquot

 and psp.box_id = bx.box_id
 and ps.order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and ps.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and bx.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 null;
 end; 
 end if;

 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 10/18/2012. IM 9181
 -- time zone change --03/02/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:shipped_products.exp_date,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :shipped_products.s_exp_date := to_char(v_local_time,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 else -- Added by AV on 05/08/2011;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure clear_details ( detail VARCHAR2, master VARCHAR2, opt number ) is
begin
 go_block(detail);
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.block_status = 'CHANGED'
 then
 clear_block(opt);
 if :system.block_status = 'CHANGED'
 then
 go_block(master);
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if;
 end if;
 clear_block;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ORDER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure clear_order_details ( checkmaster boolean, opt number ) is
begin
 if ( not checkmaster
 or ((:order.CHAPTER_ID is not null)
 or (:order.ORDER_NO is not null)) )
 then
 clear_details('items', 'order', opt);
 end if ;
 if ( (:order.CHAPTER_ID is not null)
 or (:order.ORDER_NO is not null) )
 then
 clear_details('order_status', 'order', opt);
 end if;
 if ( (:order.NOTE_ID is not null) )
 then
 clear_details('order_note', 'order', opt);
 end if;
 go_block('order');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_NOTE_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_note_id ( blk_name VARCHAR2, ino number ) is
begin
 if blk_name = 'items'
 then
 select note_id into :ctrl_blk_1.s_note_id
 from order_items
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and item_no = ino;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_note_title := 'Item';
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_item_no := ino;
 elsif blk_name = 'order_status'
 then
 select note_id into :ctrl_blk_1.s_note_id
 from orders
 where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_note_title := 'Order';
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_item_no := null;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SCROLL_NOTES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure scroll_notes (direction VARCHAR2) is
 temp_note VARCHAR2(240);
begin
 if direction = 'UP'
 then
 if :order_note.s_note_3 is not null
 then
 temp_note := :order_note.s_note_1;
 :order_note.s_note_1 := :order_note.s_note_2;
 :order_note.s_note_2 := :order_note.s_note_3;
 :order_note.s_note_3 := :order_note.s_note_4;
 :order_note.s_note_4 := :order_note.s_note_5;
 :order_note.s_note_5 := :order_note.s_note_6;
 :order_note.s_note_6 := :order_note.s_note_7;
 :order_note.s_note_7 := :order_note.s_note_8;
 :order_note.s_note_8 := :order_note.s_note_9;
 :order_note.s_note_9 := :order_note.s_note_10;
 :order_note.s_note_10:= temp_note;
 end if;
 elsif direction = 'DOWN'
 then
 if :order_note.s_note_10 is not null
 then
 temp_note := :order_note.s_note_10;
 :order_note.s_note_10:= :order_note.s_note_9;
 :order_note.s_note_9 := :order_note.s_note_8;

ProgramUnit.Name: SEPERATE_REMARKS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure seperate_remarks ( remarks in VARCHAR2,
 remarks_1 out VARCHAR2,
 remarks_2 out VARCHAR2) is
 position number(2);
begin
 if nvl(substr(remarks,31,1),' ') = ' ' or
 nvl(substr(remarks,32,1),' ') = ' '
 then
 remarks_1 := substr(remarks,1,31);
 remarks_2 := ltrim(substr(remarks,32,NVL(length(remarks), 0)));
 else
 position := instr(substr(remarks,1,31),' ',-1);
 remarks_1 := substr(remarks,1,position);
 remarks_2 := substr(remarks,position+1,NVL(length(remarks), 0));
 end if;
end;

 ORDER BY insert_date DESC, orders.customer_id
